sisi.depan: A wide stone staircase ascends to a grand candi bentar gate, its surfaces intricately carved with reliefs of warriors wearing batik sashes.
sisi.kanan: A crumbling temple wall covered in thick moss features a small, dark opening at its base, partially obscured by giant taro plants and a collapsed, bell-shaped stupa.
sisi.kiri: The massive aerial roots of a great banyan tree snake over a low stone balustrade and into a small, empty niche carved into the temple's foundation.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, a dense wall of jungle foliage rises from the banks of a shallow, rocky stream, with thick ground mist swirling around ferns and liana vines.

tengah: A single, unlit stone torch holder stands beside a large, moss-covered block of andesite, both facing the distant temple gate.
atas: The dense jungle canopy allows only slivers of the grey, overcast sky to be seen through a heavy layer of rolling mist.
